bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_WORKTREE_PREFLIGHT_READONLY\n'
printf 'PARENT='; git rev-parse --show-toplevel
printf 'PARENT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'WORKTREES\n'; git worktree list --porcelain
printf 'OWNED_CANDIDATES\n'
for dir in .worktrees/*; do
 test -d "$dir" || continue
 test -e "$dir/.git" || continue
 printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$dir"
 printf 'BRANCH='; git -C "$dir" branch --show-current
 printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$dir" rev-parse HEAD
 printf 'DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C "$dir" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l
done
